title: Direct Card Limit Basis, Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
**Rule.** The direct card limit on a Real Estate Service Contracts buyer-only order rests on a limit basis, from which the card payments already taken on the order are deducted, the limit never falling below zero and being rounded to the cent. The limit basis follows the card payments already taken on the order and how long before the payment date the order was placed:

| Card payment already taken on the order | Order placed before the payment date | Limit basis |
|---|---|---|
| yes | at least 30 calendar days | proportional: 50% of the open plan invoice amount (the plan invoices on the order less the plan-change credit memos on it), rounded to the cent |
| yes | fewer than 30 calendar days | anchored on payment history: 2 times the largest card payment taken on the order |
| none | — | flat: $400.00 |

The payment date is the date the card payment is made; the days are counted from the order date to that date.

## Illustrations of the basis (hypothetical orders, open plan invoice amount $650.00)

| Card payments already taken | Days from the order date to the payment date | Limit basis |
|---|---|---|
| none | any | $400.00 |
| one of $120.00 | 45 | 50% of $650.00: $325.00 |
| one of $120.00 | 29 | 2 times $120.00: $240.00 |
| $80.00 and $150.00 | 30 | 50% of $650.00: $325.00 |
| $80.00 and $150.00 | 12 | 2 times the largest, $150.00: $300.00 |

In each case the card payments already taken on the order are then deducted from the limit.
